groups.activity: tranq a Vizier, then let Infested damage it

rows.label: Weakened Vizier Predasite
rows.note: capture only after Infested damage it

conditions: A plain tranq capture gives only Vizier Predasite Tags, and nothing shows up in Son's Revivification menu.
Your own damage never weakens it, and lured Predasites are low level, so a modded weapon kills them outright.
Weakened Predasites despawn after a while and lured ones can bolt; capture quickly.
bonuses: Grab the Medjay tag for the Rank 3 gate on a Vome trip while you're out here.
Spare Weakened Viziers ranked to 30 donate to Son for 10 Son Tokens each.

disclosures.title: getting the Weakened hit
disclosures.body: Near-unanimous: tranq it first, then kite Infested (Chargers work well) over and go invisible or into Void mode so the aggro switches to the sleeping animal. Infested still apply Weakened to a tranquilized, invulnerable animal. If kiting fails, throw a Pherliac Pod on it and Infested pile on; the pod parts drop from Juggernauts, 50 charges a craft for 7,500 credits. Bullet-jump slams and stray fire during bounties kill wild animals, and a dead target is gone.

rows.label: Son Tokens
rows.alt: donate a maxed Predasite or Vulpaphyla for 10, gilded for 15

conditions: Only a gilded Vizier earns Mastery; gilding resets it to rank 0, so level it to 30 twice.
Once one gilded Vizier hits rank 30, no other Vizier combination gives Mastery again.
At the daily standing cap Son refuses pet donations, because a donation still tries to pay standing.
bonuses: Son Tokens also come from tag trades under Capture Deimos Wildlife and pickups on the Drift.
